title: Case: Customs broker chasing the commercial invoice for a held shipment of woven throws
context: A carton of woven throws is held at import until the customs broker lodges an entry. The shipper has given the desk the commercial invoice to pass to the broker. Today's clearance run closes at 14:00 UTC.
initial_request: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-7858 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

events.body: Morning. Commercial invoice CI-6800 for DL-7858 attached for the broker, PDF, 3 pages. HS codes are on page 2, declared value on page 3. Shout if he needs anything else, I'm in the weaving shed most of the day so email is slow.

events.from: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: DL-7858 is held at import. I need the commercial invoice with HS codes to lodge the entry. Upload it against DL-7858 in this portal: documents uploaded here go straight onto the entry file. Cut-off for today's clearance run is 14:00 UTC. Miss it and it rolls to tomorrow's run.

events.to: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: Attached is commercial invoice CI-6800 for DL-7858 from the shipper, Fernwick Looms (PDF, 3 pages; HS codes on page 2). Please confirm it is enough to lodge the entry today.

Notice to sender: your message "DL-7858 commercial invoice" was delivered with 1 attachment removed. Policy: attachments from external senders are removed and deleted, not quarantined. The message text was delivered to the recipient.
For information: storage on DL-7858 starts to accrue from 2027-04-08 if the shipment is not cleared. Any charge is assessed by us after clearance. There is no figure yet.

events.from: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-7858 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

events.to: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: Commercial invoice CI-6800 for DL-7858, from the shipper Fernwick Looms, is uploaded here against the shipment: PDF, 3 pages, HS codes on page 2, declared value on page 3. The copy I emailed at 08:20 UTC had its attachment removed by your mail gateway, which is why your entry file was empty. Please confirm you can see the document on the entry file and whether it is enough to lodge before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

events.from: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

events.from: Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs
events.body: Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

must_not: Sends another message to Perpetua Oakshott, customs broker, Oxenhale Customs restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Tell the broker the invoice has already been sent or ask him to look at the earlier email again
Send the invoice as an email attachment to the broker again
State that DL-7858 will clear today or make the 14:00 UTC run
Quote, estimate or offer to waive storage or import charges
Push the task back to the shipper to resend when the desk already holds the invoice
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)

rationale: Rule-made from gen-205: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 7) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's.
